Name: Invisibility Elixir
Author: 336tarot
Description:
This mod adds a new kind of item: Invisibility Elixir.

After drinking the Invisibility Elixir, you will activate the statue of invisibility and increase the speed by 1 for 2 minute. In the statue of invisibility, you will not be discovered by monsters, so you will not be actively attacked by them.

To obtain Invisibility Elixir, you can use 10 slimes to make it (obtain the recipe after Combat Level 1), or purchase it from the Desert Trader using 3 iridium ores.
